heroHeadline: Death Toll Climbs to 32 as 117 Areas Under Calamity, Pampanga Dam Overflow Sweeps Away Home
heroSubtitle: M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira-Obet storm sequence have killed 161+ across the cascade, with the August storm sequence alone affecting 8 million+ and 117 cities, municipalities and provinces now under a state of calamity as combined infrastructure and agricultural damage tops ₱8.43 billion, a Lubao, Pampanga home was swept away by an overflowing dam, and the Visayas grid logged its 22nd red alert of the year, prompting a DOE mandate for 250MW of battery storage
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
